99976779bf106b71916a.en: Scientists sort animals into groups by their features. One big question is whether an animal has a backbone.
99976779bf106b71916a.id: Ilmuwan mengelompokkan hewan menurut cirinya. Satu pertanyaan penting adalah apakah hewan itu punya tulang belakang (backbone).

614042384107f532d195.en: Animals with a backbone are vertebrates. There are five groups: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals.
614042384107f532d195.id: Hewan yang punya tulang belakang disebut vertebrata (vertebrates). Ada lima kelompok: ikan, amfibi, reptil, burung, dan mamalia.

5444e8870b09205854d9.en: Fish have gills and scales. Amphibians have moist skin, and their young usually live in water.
5444e8870b09205854d9.id: Ikan punya insang dan sisik. Amfibi punya kulit lembap, dan anaknya biasanya hidup di air.

94b81ed4e786886ac1c5.en: Reptiles have dry, scaly skin. Birds have feathers, and mammals have hair and feed their young on milk.
94b81ed4e786886ac1c5.id: Reptil punya kulit kering dan bersisik. Burung punya bulu, sedangkan mamalia punya rambut dan menyusui anaknya.

9d51334095dbf14a6dd8.en: Animals without a backbone are invertebrates. Insects, spiders, snails, worms and crabs are all invertebrates.
9d51334095dbf14a6dd8.id: Hewan tanpa tulang belakang disebut invertebrata (invertebrates). Serangga, laba-laba, siput, cacing, dan kepiting semuanya invertebrata.

c280998aff4990dab049.en: Insects have six legs and three body parts. Spiders have eight legs and two body parts.
c280998aff4990dab049.id: Serangga punya enam kaki dan tiga bagian tubuh. Laba-laba punya delapan kaki dan dua bagian tubuh.
